data.one_liner: Programmatically set device orientation on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: The plugin exposes static methods to lock the device orientation to landscape or portrait, including auto modes that use sensor data. It handles platform differences and works without calling SystemChrome directly.
use_when: When building a video player that needs to switch to landscape full-screen
When you want to lock orientation during a specific screen or flow
When you need to enforce a particular orientation without user rotation
avoid_when: When you want the user to rotate freely
When targeting web or desktop platforms
strengths: Supports iOS <16 and Android V2 embedding
Handles auto modes with sensor data
weaknesses: Some modes may not work on iOS (e.g., portraitDown)
